desc: Derive a complete mathematical characterization of feasible row and column thresholds for black and white fixed cells.
Design an \(O(M\log M)\) feasibility algorithm using row thresholds and monotonicity.
Prove correctness, including equality conventions, unobserved rows and columns, and prefix conditions.
Identify sorting and dictionary storage sufficient for \(M\le 2\cdot10^5\).
Test against all samples and edge cases.
Implement the final stdin/stdout Python solution with \(O(M\log M)\) time and \(O(M)\) memory.
